## Conventions

### Base path and formats

Routes live under `/api/v1` below the app path (for example `https://kloister.example.org/kloister/api/v1/health` when the app is served at `/kloister/`). Requests and responses are JSON unless a route says otherwise. Dates without a time are `YYYY-MM-DD` strings; timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC.

### Authentication

Sign in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. The answer sets the `sid` cookie (HttpOnly, scoped to the app path), which every other request sends. Routes marked "Public" need no session. While an account still has its temporary password, only the routes marked "Also allowed while the temporary password still has to be changed" work; the rest answer 403 `PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED`.

Every request that is not GET, HEAD or OPTIONS must send the header `x-requested-with: kloister`, sign-in included. Browsers cannot add this header to a cross-site form post, so it protects the cookie session against cross-site request forgery; without it the API answers 403 `CSRF_HEADER_MISSING`.

### Permissions

Each route names who may call it. Project routes (`/api/v1/projects/{id}/...`, where `{id}` is the project uuid or its key) need a project permission; the role list after each permission comes from the role table in `packages/shared/src/projects.ts`. Non-members get 404, so a project's existence is not disclosed. Items outside the caller's visibility scope also answer 404. Routes under `/api/v1/admin` need the system administrator role. Personal spaces are the exception to the role lists: only their owner reaches them (everyone else, administrators included, gets 404), and the members, teams, timeline, holidays, ADO and archive routes answer 404 even to the owner. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the complete rules.

### Item references

`{item}` in a path is the item uuid or its number within the project (`42` for `KLO-42`).

### Pagination

List routes that take `cursor` and `limit` return `{ items, nextCursor }`. Pass the previous `nextCursor` as `cursor` to get the next page; `nextCursor` is null on the last page. `limit` is 1 to 100 (default 50).

### Errors

Every error has the [`ApiError`](#apierror) shape `{ code, message, details? }`. `message` is safe to show to users; `code` is stable.

| Status | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400    | `VALIDATION_FAILED`: a parameter or body field is invalid; `details` lists `{ field, messages }` per field. A password change with a wrong current password answers `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`.      |
| 401    | `UNAUTHENTICATED`: no valid session cookie. Sign-in with a wrong email or password answers `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`.                                                                               |
| 403    | `FORBIDDEN` (the role or a rule does not allow it), `PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED` (the temporary password must be changed first) or `CSRF_HEADER_MISSING` (a write without the header).            |
| 404    | `NOT_FOUND`: it does not exist, or the caller may not know it exists (non-members, items outside the visibility scope).                                                                         |
| 409    | `CONFLICT` or a specific code (`PROJECT_ARCHIVED`, `HAS_CHILDREN`, `BUCKET_NOT_EMPTY`, `LAST_ADMIN`, `LAST_PM`, `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`, `BACKUP_RUNNING`): the change clashes with the current state. |
| 413    | `FILE_TOO_LARGE`: the upload exceeds the size limit. A body above the request limit of the route also answers 413.                                                                              |
| 415    | `UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE`: the file content is not an accepted type.                                                                                                                              |
| 429    | `RATE_LIMITED`: too many sign-in attempts; see the `Retry-After` header.                                                                                                                        |
| 500    | `INTERNAL`: an unexpected server error; details go to the server log only.                                                                                                                      |

Codes: `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `UNAUTHENTICATED`, `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`, `PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED`, `CSRF_HEADER_MISSING`, `FORBIDDEN`, `NOT_FOUND`, `CONFLICT`, `LAST_ADMIN`, `LAST_PM`, `PROJECT_ARCHIVED`, `HAS_CHILDREN`, `BUCKET_NOT_EMPTY`, `RATE_LIMITED`, `FILE_TOO_LARGE`, `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`, `UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE`, `BACKUP_RUNNING`, `INTERNAL`.

### Limits

- JSON bodies: up to 1 MiB (Fastify's default), except the ADO sample and incoming-preview routes, which take up to 24 MiB because they carry a CSV of up to 10 MiB, 1,000 data rows and 1 MiB per cell.
- Sign-in: a fixed number of attempts per client address per window (`LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT`, default 10, per `LOGIN_RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS`, default 60); more answer 429 with `Retry-After`.
- Uploads (`application/octet-stream` bodies with an `x-file-name` header): the size limit and project quota are admin settings (`GET /api/v1/admin/settings/storage`).

## Auth

Session endpoints under `/api/v1/auth` (SPEC §5, §8).

### POST /api/v1/auth/login

Signs in and sets the session cookie.

**Permission:** Public: no session needed.

**Request body** (`application/json`)

Type: [LoginDto](#logindto)

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [UserDto](#userdto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 429 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### POST /api/v1/auth/logout

Ends the current session and clears the cookie.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user. Also allowed while the temporary password still has to be changed.

**Responses**

- **204** Done; no body.
- Errors: 401, 403, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### POST /api/v1/auth/change-password

Changes the caller's own password and ends their other sessions.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user. Also allowed while the temporary password still has to be changed.

**Request body** (`application/json`)

Type: [ChangePasswordDto](#changepassworddto)

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [UserDto](#userdto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Me

**Permission:** Any signed-in user. Also allowed while the temporary password still has to be changed.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [UserDto](#userdto)

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [UserDto](#userdto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### GET /api/v1/me/theme

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [MyThemeDto](#mythemedto)

- Errors: 401, 403 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### PUT /api/v1/me/theme

Sets the caller's own theme (mode, primary and accent colour).

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

**Request body** (`application/json`)

Type: [ThemeBody](#themebody)

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [MyThemeDto](#mythemedto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### DELETE /api/v1/me/theme

Clears the caller's own theme, so the admin default applies.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [MyThemeDto](#mythemedto)

- Errors: 401, 403, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Work

A person's work across projects under `/api/v1/users/:userId/work` (SPEC §6 "View all their work").

### GET /api/v1/me/work

Lists assigned/created project work and the caller's personal tasks.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

| Parameter        | In    | Type                                                | Required | Description                                                         |
| ---------------- | ----- | --------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cursor`         | query | string (uuid)                                       | no       | Id of the last item already received.                               |
| `limit`          | query | number                                              | no       | Page size, 1 to {@link MAX_PAGE_LIMIT}.                             |
| `includeDone`    | query | boolean                                             | no       | Include Done items (default false: open work only).                 |
| `includeCreated` | query | boolean                                             | no       | Include project items created by the selected person.               |
| `source`         | query | `"ALL"`, `"PROJECTS"`, `"PERSONAL"`                 | no       | My work source; other people's personal work is never included.     |
| `projectId`      | query | string (uuid)                                       | no       | Restrict to a readable project; inaccessible ids return no matches. |
| `type`           | query | `"EPIC"`, `"FEATURE"`, `"STORY"`, `"TASK"`, `"BUG"` | no       | Item type.                                                          |
| `labelId`        | query | string (uuid)                                       | no       | Per-project label id.                                               |
| `dueFrom`        | query | string                                              | no       | Inclusive due-date lower bound.                                     |
| `dueTo`          | query | string                                              | no       | Inclusive due-date upper bound.                                     |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [UserWorkDto](#userworkdto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Work snapshots

My work snapshots never include administrative cross-project reach.

### GET /api/v1/me/snapshots/preview

Previews only the caller's eligible work.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

| Parameter        | In    | Type                                                          | Required | Description                                                                                                                     |
| ---------------- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cursor`         | query | string (uuid)                                                 | no       | Id of the last item already received.                                                                                           |
| `limit`          | query | number                                                        | no       | Page size, 1 to {@link MAX_PAGE_LIMIT}.                                                                                         |
| `type`           | query | `"EPIC"`, `"FEATURE"`, `"STORY"`, `"TASK"`, `"BUG"`           | no       | Only this type.                                                                                                                 |
| `status`         | query | `"NOT_STARTED"`, `"IN_PROGRESS"`, `"BLOCKED"`, `"DONE"`       | no       | Only this status.                                                                                                               |
| `bucketId`       | query | string                                                        | no       | Only this bucket, or `none`.                                                                                                    |
| `sprintId`       | query | string                                                        | no       | Only this sprint, or `none` (backlog).                                                                                          |
| `teamId`         | query | string                                                        | no       | Only this team, or `none`.                                                                                                      |
| `parentId`       | query | string                                                        | no       | Only children of this item, or `none` for top-level items.                                                                      |
| `assigneeId`     | query | string (uuid)                                                 | no       | Only items assigned to this user.                                                                                               |
| `labelId`        | query | string (uuid)                                                 | no       | Only items with this label.                                                                                                     |
| `dueFrom`        | query | string                                                        | no       | Due on or after this date.                                                                                                      |
| `dueTo`          | query | string                                                        | no       | Due on or before this date.                                                                                                     |
| `ids`            | query | string (uuid)[]                                               | no       | Only these items: comma-separated uuids, at most {@link ITEM_IDS_FILTER_MAX} (live updates refetch changed items, M10).         |
| `q`              | query | string                                                        | no       | Case-insensitive title search; a number also matches the item number.                                                           |
| `sort`           | query | `"number"`, `"position"`                                      | no       | `number` (default) or `position` (board order).                                                                                 |
| `boardOnly`      | query | boolean                                                       | no       | Filtered board shows only items on a board; all-eligible includes off-board items.                                              |
| `unassigned`     | query | boolean                                                       | no       | Filtered board's unassigned chip.                                                                                               |
| `scope`          | query | `"filtered"`, `"all"`                                         | no       | Filtered screen or every eligible item from the same source.                                                                    |
| `offline`        | query | boolean                                                       | no       | Include permitted files and original rich text for offline reading.                                                             |
| `source`         | query | `"ALL"`, `"PROJECTS"`, `"PERSONAL"`                           | no       | My work source retained in both scope modes.                                                                                    |
| `includeCreated` | query | boolean                                                       | no       | My work's created-item option, retained in both scope modes.                                                                    |
| `includeDone`    | query | boolean                                                       | no       | My work's Done option, retained in both scope modes.                                                                            |
| `projectId`      | query | string (uuid)                                                 | no       | Narrow My work to a project.                                                                                                    |
| `dueGroup`       | query | `"Overdue"`, `"Today"`, `"This week"`, `"Later"`, `"No date"` | no       | Named due group from the work screen.                                                                                           |
| `today`          | query | string                                                        | no       | Viewer's calendar day used for work due grouping.                                                                               |
| `show`           | query | `"done-recent"`, `"ad-hoc"`                                   | no       | The backlog's "Show" filter (v1.4.0): items Done in the last 14 days, or open ad-hoc items, as the Overview report counts them. |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  An object:

  | Field     | Type   | Required | Description |
  | --------- | ------ | -------- | ----------- |
  | `scope`   | string | yes      |             |
  | `mode`    | string | yes      |             |
  | `count`   | number | yes      |             |
  | `filters` | string | yes      |             |
  | `details` | string | yes      |             |

- Errors: 400, 401, 403 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Personal

Own personal space only; owner identity always comes from the session.

### GET /api/v1/me/personal

Reads the caller's space, or returns 404 before first use.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [ProjectDto](#projectdto)

- Errors: 401, 403, 404 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### POST /api/v1/me/personal

Initializes the caller's space; the global CSRF guard protects this write.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [ProjectDto](#projectdto)

- Errors: 401, 403, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Projects

Project collection routes under `/api/v1/projects` (SPEC §8).

### GET /api/v1/projects

Lists the caller's projects, or every project for admins with `scope=all`.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

| Parameter         | In    | Type              | Required | Description                                                 |
| ----------------- | ----- | ----------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `scope`           | query | `"mine"`, `"all"` | no       | `mine` (default) or `all`; `all` is for system admins only. |
| `includeArchived` | query | boolean           | no       | Include archived projects (default false).                  |
| `q`               | query | string            | no       | Case-insensitive substring match on key or name.            |
| `cursor`          | query | string (uuid)     | no       | Id of the last item already received.                       |
| `limit`           | query | number            | no       | Page size, 1 to {@link MAX_PAGE_LIMIT}.                     |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  An object:

  | Field        | Type                        | Required | Description                                                            |
  | ------------ | --------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `items`      | [ProjectDto](#projectdto)[] | yes      | Items on this page, newest first unless the endpoint says otherwise.   |
  | `nextCursor` | string or null              | yes      | Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more items. |

- Errors: 400, 401, 403 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### POST /api/v1/projects

Creates a project and assigns its first PM. Admins only.

**Permission:** System administrators only.

**Request body** (`application/json`)

Type: [CreateProjectDto](#createprojectdto)

**Responses**

- **201** Success.

  Type: [ProjectDto](#projectdto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Project

Single-project routes under `/api/v1/projects/:id`, where `:id` is the project uuid or key.

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}

Returns the project with the caller's role and permissions. Permissions: any member; any admin (audited if not a member).

**Permission:** Project member with `VIEW_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER, VIEWER; system administrators in every ordinary project). Non-members get 404.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [ProjectDto](#projectdto)

- Errors: 401, 403, 404 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### PATCH /api/v1/projects/{id}

Changes name, description or settings. Permissions: PM only.

**Permission:** Project member with `MANAGE_PROJECT` (PM). Non-members get 404.

**Request body** (`application/json`)

Type: [UpdateProjectDto](#updateprojectdto)

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [ProjectDto](#projectdto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/archive

Archives the project, making it read-only. Permissions: PM only.

**Permission:** Project member with `MANAGE_PROJECT` (PM). Non-members get 404.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [ProjectDto](#projectdto)

- Errors: 401, 403, 404, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/unarchive

Unarchives the project. Permissions: PM only; allowed while archived.

**Permission:** Project member with `MANAGE_PROJECT` (PM). Non-members get 404. Allowed on archived projects.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [ProjectDto](#projectdto)

- Errors: 401, 403, 404, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Members

Membership routes under `/api/v1/projects/:id/members` (SPEC §8), plus the candidate search used to add members.

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/members

Lists members. Permissions: any member; any admin (audited if not a member).

**Permission:** Project member with `VIEW_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER, VIEWER; system administrators in every ordinary project). Non-members get 404.

| Parameter | In    | Type          | Required | Description                             |
| --------- | ----- | ------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `cursor`  | query | string (uuid) | no       | Id of the last item already received.   |
| `limit`   | query | number        | no       | Page size, 1 to {@link MAX_PAGE_LIMIT}. |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  An object:

  | Field        | Type                                    | Required | Description                                                            |
  | ------------ | --------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `items`      | [ProjectMemberDto](#projectmemberdto)[] | yes      | Items on this page, newest first unless the endpoint says otherwise.   |
  | `nextCursor` | string or null                          | yes      | Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more items. |

## Items

Work items under `/api/v1/projects/:id/items` (SPEC §8 `items`, `/move`, `/children`). `:item` is the item's uuid or its per-project number.

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/items

Lists visible items. Permissions: any member and admin, within scope.

**Permission:** Project member with `VIEW_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER, VIEWER; system administrators in every ordinary project). Non-members get 404.

| Parameter    | In    | Type                                                    | Required | Description                                                                                                             |
| ------------ | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cursor`     | query | string (uuid)                                           | no       | Id of the last item already received.                                                                                   |
| `limit`      | query | number                                                  | no       | Page size, 1 to {@link MAX_PAGE_LIMIT}.                                                                                 |
| `type`       | query | `"EPIC"`, `"FEATURE"`, `"STORY"`, `"TASK"`, `"BUG"`     | no       | Only this type.                                                                                                         |
| `status`     | query | `"NOT_STARTED"`, `"IN_PROGRESS"`, `"BLOCKED"`, `"DONE"` | no       | Only this status.                                                                                                       |
| `bucketId`   | query | string                                                  | no       | Only this bucket, or `none`.                                                                                            |
| `sprintId`   | query | string                                                  | no       | Only this sprint, or `none` (backlog).                                                                                  |
| `teamId`     | query | string                                                  | no       | Only this team, or `none`.                                                                                              |
| `parentId`   | query | string                                                  | no       | Only children of this item, or `none` for top-level items.                                                              |
| `assigneeId` | query | string (uuid)                                           | no       | Only items assigned to this user.                                                                                       |
| `labelId`    | query | string (uuid)                                           | no       | Only items with this label.                                                                                             |
| `dueFrom`    | query | string                                                  | no       | Due on or after this date.                                                                                              |
| `dueTo`      | query | string                                                  | no       | Due on or before this date.                                                                                             |
| `ids`        | query | string (uuid)[]                                         | no       | Only these items: comma-separated uuids, at most {@link ITEM_IDS_FILTER_MAX} (live updates refetch changed items, M10). |
| `q`          | query | string                                                  | no       | Case-insensitive title search; a number also matches the item number.                                                   |
| `sort`       | query | `"number"`, `"position"`                                | no       | `number` (default) or `position` (board order).                                                                         |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  An object:

  | Field        | Type                          | Required | Description                                                            |
  | ------------ | ----------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `items`      | [WorkItemDto](#workitemdto)[] | yes      | Items on this page, newest first unless the endpoint says otherwise.   |
  | `nextCursor` | string or null                | yes      | Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more items. |

  Example:

  ```json
  {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "0c8e4f2a-6b1d-4e3f-a5c7-9d0b1e2f3a4b",
        "number": 42,
        "key": "KLO-42",
        "type": "TASK",
        "parentId": "3b9a7c1d-2e4f-4a6b-8c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d",
        "ancestors": [
          {
            "id": "3b9a7c1d-2e4f-4a6b-8c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d",
            "number": 7,
            "key": "KLO-7",
            "type": "EPIC",
            "title": "Spring release"
          }
        ],
        "title": "Write the upgrade notes",
        "description": "<p>Cover the new timeline settings.</p>",
        "status": "NOT_STARTED",
        "priority": 2,
        "bucketId": "9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-8c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d",
        "sprintId": "5d4c3b2a-1f0e-4d9c-8b7a-6f5e4d3c2b1a",
        "teamId": null,
        "startDate": "2026-11-09",
        "startSecondHalf": false,
        "dueDate": "2026-11-11",
        "dueFirstHalf": false,
        "dueTime": null,
        "startNoEarlierThan": null,
        "position": 1024,
        "outlinePosition": null,
        "createdById": "6f1d2c4e-8a0b-4c3d-9e5f-0a1b2c3d4e5f",
        "assigneeIds": ["6f1d2c4e-8a0b-4c3d-9e5f-0a1b2c3d4e5f"],
        "assigneeShares": [
          {
            "userId": "6f1d2c4e-8a0b-4c3d-9e5f-0a1b2c3d4e5f",
            "share": 100
          }
        ],
        "labelIds": [],
        "checklist": {
          "done": 0,
          "total": 0
        },
        "childCount": 0,
        "adHoc": false,
        "completedAt": null,
        "createdAt": "2026-11-02T09:15:00.000Z",
        "updatedAt": "2026-11-02T09:15:00.000Z",
        "can": {
          "edit": true,
          "plan": true,
          "move": true,
          "delete": true,
          "deleteCascade": true,
          "annotate": true
        }
      }
    ],
    "nextCursor": null
  }
  ```

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/items/{item}

Returns one item. Permissions: visible items only (404 otherwise).

| --------- | ---- | ------ | -------- | -------------------- |
| `item`    | path | string | yes      | Item uuid or number. |

### PATCH /api/v1/projects/{id}/items/{item}

Edits an item. Permissions: `EDIT_ANY_ITEM`, or `EDIT_OWN_ITEMS` on own items, or leading the item's team; plan fields also need ProjectAccessService.canPlanItem (M9.2).

**Permission:** Project member with `EDIT_ANY_ITEM` (PM, LEAD) or `EDIT_OWN_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER). Non-members get 404.

| Parameter | In   | Type   | Required | Description          |
| --------- | ---- | ------ | -------- | -------------------- |
| `item`    | path | string | yes      | Item uuid or number. |

```json
{

    }
  ]
}
```

### DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id}/items/{item}

Moves an item to the project's trash (`?cascade=true` with its subtree, M12); restoring the returned batch is the Undo. Permissions: `DELETE_ANY_ITEM`, or `DELETE_OWN_ITEMS` on own childless items while the project lets Members change the plan (M9.2), or leading the item's team (no cascade).

**Permission:** Project member with `DELETE_ANY_ITEM` (PM, LEAD) or `DELETE_OWN_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER). Non-members get 404.

| Parameter | In    | Type    | Required | Description                                                        |
| --------- | ----- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `item`    | path  | string  | yes      | Item uuid or number.                                               |
| `cascade` | query | boolean | no       | Delete the item's whole subtree too (SPEC §4.1; PM and Lead only). |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [DeleteItemResult](#deleteitemresult)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/items/{item}/images

Uploads an image. Permissions: `ANNOTATE_ITEMS` on a visible item.

**Permission:** Project member with `ANNOTATE_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER). Non-members get 404.

The file's bytes; its name goes in the `x-file-name` header.

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 415 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/items/{item}/images/{imageId}

Sends an image with its detected type and `nosniff`. Browsers must ask again each time (`no-cache`), so an image is never shown from a cache to someone who can no longer see its item. Permissions: visible items.

**Permission:** Project member with `VIEW_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER, VIEWER; system administrators in every ordinary project). Non-members get 404.

| `imageId` | path | string | yes      | Image id.            |

**Responses**

- **200** The file, with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`. (`image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/gif`, `image/webp`)

## Timeline

The project timeline under `/api/v1/projects/:id/timeline` (SPEC §6.4).

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/timeline

Lists the dependency links whose both ends the caller can see. Permissions: any member and admin, within scope.

**Permission:** Project member with `VIEW_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER, VIEWER; system administrators in every ordinary project). Non-members get 404.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [TimelineDto](#timelinedto)

- Errors: 401, 403, 404 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/timeline/msproject

Downloads the plan as a Microsoft Project XML file (v1.3.2), built from what the caller can see: items on the timeline, links between them, assignees and holidays. Project opens it with File > Open. Permissions: any member and admin, within scope; archived projects too.

**Permission:** Project member with `VIEW_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER, VIEWER; system administrators in every ordinary project). Non-members get 404.

**Responses**

- **200** Success. (`application/xml`)
- Errors: 401, 403, 404 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/timeline/reschedule

Previews or applies a date change with its dependent moves. Permissions: `EDIT_ANY_ITEM` or `EDIT_OWN_ITEMS`; each requested item must be visible (404) and its plan changeable by the caller (403, ProjectAccessService.canPlanItem).

**Permission:** Project member with `EDIT_ANY_ITEM` (PM, LEAD) or `EDIT_OWN_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER). Non-members get 404.

**Request body** (`application/json`)

Type: [RescheduleDto](#rescheduledto)

Example:

```json
{
  "mode": "preview",
  "changes": [
    {
      "item": "42",
      "startDate": "2026-11-10",
      "dueDate": "2026-11-12"
    }
  ],
  "expect": {
    "0c8e4f2a-6b1d-4e3f-a5c7-9d0b1e2f3a4b": "2026-11-02T09:15:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [RescheduleResultDto](#rescheduleresultdto)

  Example:

  ```json
  {
    "changes": [
      {
        "item": {
          "id": "0c8e4f2a-6b1d-4e3f-a5c7-9d0b1e2f3a4b",
          "number": 42,
          "key": "KLO-42",
          "type": "TASK",
          "title": "Write the upgrade notes"
        },
        "from": {
          "startDate": "2026-11-09",
          "startSecondHalf": false,
          "dueDate": "2026-11-11",
          "dueFirstHalf": false
        },
        "to": {
          "startDate": "2026-11-10",
          "startSecondHalf": false,
          "dueDate": "2026-11-12",
          "dueFirstHalf": false
        },
        "pinFrom": null,
        "pinTo": null,
        "requested": true,
        "snapped": false,
        "version": "2026-11-02T09:15:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "kept": [],
    "items": [],
    "rescheduleId": null
  }
  ```

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Project holidays

A project's holidays under `/api/v1/projects/:id/holidays` (SPEC §6.4, M9.1). Permissions: ProjectAccessGuard (non-members and personal spaces 404, writes refused on archived projects); reading needs `VIEW_ITEMS`, changes need `MANAGE_BOARD` (PMs and Leads).

| `limit`          | query | number                                                        | no       | Page size, 1 to {@link MAX_PAGE_LIMIT}.                                                                                         |
| `type`           | query | `"EPIC"`, `"FEATURE"`, `"STORY"`, `"TASK"`, `"BUG"`           | no       | Only this type.                                                                                                                 |
| `status`         | query | `"NOT_STARTED"`, `"IN_PROGRESS"`, `"BLOCKED"`, `"DONE"`       | no       | Only this status.                                                                                                               |
| `bucketId`       | query | string                                                        | no       | Only this bucket, or `none`.                                                                                                    |
| `sprintId`       | query | string                                                        | no       | Only this sprint, or `none` (backlog).                                                                                          |
| `teamId`         | query | string                                                        | no       | Only this team, or `none`.                                                                                                      |
| `parentId`       | query | string                                                        | no       | Only children of this item, or `none` for top-level items.                                                                      |
| `assigneeId`     | query | string (uuid)                                                 | no       | Only items assigned to this user.                                                                                               |
| `labelId`        | query | string (uuid)                                                 | no       | Only items with this label.                                                                                                     |

## Live updates

Live updates (M10 plan section 6): the Server-Sent Events stream and its control routes, under `/api/v1/events`.

### GET /api/v1/events/status

Reports whether live updates are on, so the web app knows whether to open a stream.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [LiveStatusDto](#livestatusdto)

- Errors: 401, 403 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### GET /api/v1/events

Opens the event stream; the first event is `hello` with the stream id. Answers 204 (which browsers do not retry) while live updates are off. The response is never compressed or cached and asks proxies not to buffer it (M10 plan section 7).

Events (`event:` line, then a `data:` line with JSON):

| Event            | Data              |
| ---------------- | ----------------- |
| `hello`          | `LiveHelloDto`    |
| `item-changed`   | `LiveItemsDto`    |
| `item-removed`   | `LiveItemsDto`    |
| `links-changed`  | `LiveLinksDto`    |
| `board-changed`  | `LiveProjectDto`  |
| `access-changed` | `LiveProjectDto`  |
| `notification`   | `{}`              |
| `presence`       | `LivePresenceDto` |
| `project-resync` | `LiveProjectDto`  |
| `resync`         | `{}`              |
| `disabled`       | `{}`              |

A comment line `: heartbeat` keeps the connection open; the first message also sets `retry: 5000`.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

| Parameter | In    | Type   | Required | Description                                            |
| --------- | ----- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `client`  | query | string | no       | The tab's client id (EventSource cannot send headers). |

**Responses**

- **200** Success. (`text/event-stream`)
- **204** Live updates are switched off; browsers do not retry a 204.
- Errors: 400, 401, 403 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### PUT /api/v1/events/{streamId}/project

Follows a project with the stream, or none.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

| Parameter  | In   | Type   | Required | Description |
| ---------- | ---- | ------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `streamId` | path | string | yes      | The stream. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

Type: [LiveSubscribeDto](#livesubscribedto)

**Responses**

- **204** Done; no body.
- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### PUT /api/v1/events/{streamId}/work

Follows a person's work with the stream (v1.4.0), so "all their work" refreshes when their items change, or none (null: the caller's own work). Events still pass the caller's own visibility in each project they are a member of; personal spaces of others never match.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

| Parameter  | In   | Type   | Required | Description |
| ---------- | ---- | ------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `streamId` | path | string | yes      | The stream. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

Type: [LiveWorkDto](#liveworkdto)

**Responses**

- **204** Done; no body.
- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### PUT /api/v1/events/{streamId}/presence

Reports what the tab is doing (presence); kept in memory only.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

| Parameter  | In   | Type   | Required | Description |
| ---------- | ---- | ------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `streamId` | path | string | yes      | The stream. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

Type: [LivePresenceDto](#livepresencedto)

**Responses**

- **204** Done; no body.
- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

- **200** Success.

  Type: [TemporaryPasswordResponse](#temporarypasswordresponse)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

- **200** Success.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

### PUT /api/v1/admin/settings/storage

**Permission:** System administrators only.

Type: [StorageSettingsBody](#storagesettingsbody)

- **200** Success.

Measures the disk usage of the app's folder, attachments, backups and logs, plus the free space of the disk.

### GET /api/v1/admin/settings/logs

Returns the log retention in effect.

### PUT /api/v1/admin/settings/logs

**Permission:** System administrators only.

Type: [LogSettingsBody](#logsettingsbody)

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### GET /api/v1/admin/settings/live

## Admin branding

Branding settings under `/api/v1/admin/settings/branding` (SPEC §6 Admin): app name, logo upload and the UI font (a preset or uploaded files). Uploads send the raw file as an `application/octet-stream` body with its name in the `x-file-name` header.

### GET /api/v1/admin/settings/branding

Returns the branding settings.

**Permission:** System administrators only.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [BrandingSettingsDto](#brandingsettingsdto)

- Errors: 401, 403 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### PUT /api/v1/admin/settings/branding

Saves the app name and the font.

**Permission:** System administrators only.

**Request body** (`application/json`)

Type: [BrandingBody](#brandingbody)

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [BrandingSettingsDto](#brandingsettingsdto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### PUT /api/v1/admin/settings/branding/logo

Uploads a new logo (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP by content, at most 1 MB).

**Permission:** System administrators only.

**Request body** (`application/octet-stream`)

The file's bytes; its name goes in the `x-file-name` header.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [BrandingSettingsDto](#brandingsettingsdto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 409, 413, 415 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### DELETE /api/v1/admin/settings/branding/logo

Removes the logo.

**Permission:** System administrators only.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [BrandingSettingsDto](#brandingsettingsdto)

- Errors: 401, 403, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### PUT /api/v1/admin/settings/branding/fonts/{weight}

Uploads the regular or bold font file (WOFF2, WOFF, TTF or OTF by content, at most 10 MB).

**Permission:** System administrators only.

| Parameter | In   | Type   | Required | Description          |
| --------- | ---- | ------ | -------- | -------------------- |
| `weight`  | path | string | yes      | `regular` or `bold`. |

**Request body** (`application/octet-stream`)

The file's bytes; its name goes in the `x-file-name` header.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [BrandingSettingsDto](#brandingsettingsdto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 415 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### DELETE /api/v1/admin/settings/branding/fonts/{weight}

Removes a font file; removing the regular one removes both and switches an uploaded font back to Figtree.

**Permission:** System administrators only.

| Parameter | In   | Type   | Required | Description          |
| --------- | ---- | ------ | -------- | -------------------- |
| `weight`  | path | string | yes      | `regular` or `bold`. |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [BrandingSettingsDto](#brandingsettingsdto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Audit log

Audit log viewer API (SPEC §6 Admin, §8 `admin/audit`).

### GET /api/v1/admin/audit

Lists audit entries newest first, with optional filters.

**Permission:** System administrators only.

| Parameter    | In    | Type               | Required | Description                                 |
| ------------ | ----- | ------------------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `actorId`    | query | string (uuid)      | no       | Only entries by this actor.                 |
| `action`     | query | string             | no       | Only entries with this action.              |
| `entityType` | query | string             | no       | Only entries about this entity type.        |
| `entityId`   | query | string             | no       | Only entries about this entity id.          |
| `projectId`  | query | string (uuid)      | no       | Only entries in this project.               |
| `from`       | query | string (date-time) | no       | ISO timestamp; only entries at or after it. |
| `to`         | query | string (date-time) | no       | ISO timestamp; only entries before it.      |
| `cursor`     | query | string (uuid)      | no       | Id of the last item already received.       |
| `limit`      | query | number             | no       | Page size, 1 to {@link MAX_PAGE_LIMIT}.     |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  An object:

  | Field        | Type                              | Required | Description                                                            |
  | ------------ | --------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `items`      | [AuditEntryDto](#auditentrydto)[] | yes      | Items on this page, newest first unless the endpoint says otherwise.   |
  | `nextCursor` | string or null                    | yes      | Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more items. |

- Errors: 400, 401, 403 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Calendar

The signed-in user's calendar under `/api/v1/me/calendar` (SPEC §6.5, M13).

### GET /api/v1/me/calendar

Lists the caller's items and holidays in a date range of at most 100 days. Permissions: any signed-in user; own visible items only.

| `from`    | query | string | yes      | First day (`YYYY-MM-DD`).                               |
| `to`      | query | string | yes      | Last day (`YYYY-MM-DD`), at most 100 days after `from`. |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [MyCalendarDto](#mycalendardto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## References

Item references in rich text (M12): previews for hover cards and the "Referenced in" list of an item.

### GET /api/v1/references

Previews referenced items by key (`KLO-12`). Permissions: signed in; unknown, hidden and trashed items are left out.

**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

| Parameter | In    | Type     | Required | Description                                                |
| --------- | ----- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `keys`    | query | string[] | yes      | Canonical item keys, comma-separated, e.g. `KLO-12,OPS-3`. |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [ItemPreviewDto](#itempreviewdto)[]

- Errors: 400, 401, 403 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/items/{item}/referenced-in

Lists the visible items whose description or notes name this item. Permissions: any member and admin, within scope; 404 unless the item is visible.

**Permission:** Project member with `VIEW_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER, VIEWER; system administrators in every ordinary project). Non-members get 404.

| Parameter | In   | Type   | Required | Description          |
| --------- | ---- | ------ | -------- | -------------------- |
| `item`    | path | string | yes      | Item uuid or number. |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [ItemReferrerDto](#itemreferrerdto)[]

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Reports

Project reports under `/api/v1/projects/:id/reports` (SPEC §6.5, M13).

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/reports/overview

Counts the visible items by status, due date and bucket. Permissions: any member and admin (`VIEW_ITEMS`), visible items only.

**Permission:** Project member with `VIEW_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER, VIEWER; system administrators in every ordinary project). Non-members get 404.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [OverviewReportDto](#overviewreportdto)

- Errors: 401, 403, 404 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/reports/sprint

Reports on the active (or a chosen) sprint from visible items and their history. Permissions: any member and admin (`VIEW_ITEMS`), visible items only; personal spaces 404.

**Permission:** Project member with `VIEW_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER, VIEWER; system administrators in every ordinary project). Non-members get 404.

| Parameter | In    | Type          | Required | Description                                          |
| --------- | ----- | ------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `sprint`  | query | string (uuid) | no       | Sprint to report on; the active sprint when omitted. |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [SprintReportDto](#sprintreportdto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/reports/workload

Spreads visible planned work over people and weeks, by assignee share. Permissions: any member and admin (`VIEW_ITEMS`), visible items only.

**Permission:** Project member with `VIEW_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER, VIEWER; system administrators in every ordinary project). Non-members get 404.

| Parameter | In    | Type   | Required | Description                                                     |
| --------- | ----- | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `from`    | query | string | no       | A day in the first week (`YYYY-MM-DD`); this week when omitted. |
| `weeks`   | query | number | no       | Number of weeks, 1 to 26; default 8.                            |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [WorkloadReportDto](#workloadreportdto)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/reports/plan-health

Lists past-due items, timeline conflicts, undated sprint work and late pins. Permissions: any member and admin (`VIEW_ITEMS`), visible items and links only; personal spaces 404.

**Permission:** Project member with `VIEW_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER, VIEWER; system administrators in every ordinary project). Non-members get 404.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [PlanHealthReportDto](#planhealthreportdto)

- Errors: 401, 403, 404 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Trash

A project's trash under `/api/v1/projects/:id/trash` (M12): deleted items by delete batch, restore and permanent delete.

### GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/trash

Lists the delete batches, newest first, with the caller's visible items. Permissions: `DELETE_ANY_ITEM` or `DELETE_OWN_ITEMS`.

**Permission:** Project member with `DELETE_ANY_ITEM` (PM, LEAD) or `DELETE_OWN_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER). Non-members get 404.

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [TrashBatchDto](#trashbatchdto)[]

- Errors: 401, 403, 404 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/trash/{batchId}/restore

Restores a delete batch. Permissions: `DELETE_ANY_ITEM`, or `DELETE_OWN_ITEMS` for a single item the caller deleted or whose team they lead; 404 unless its deleted item is visible.

**Permission:** Project member with `DELETE_ANY_ITEM` (PM, LEAD) or `DELETE_OWN_ITEMS` (PM, LEAD, MEMBER). Non-members get 404.

| Parameter | In   | Type   | Required | Description       |
| --------- | ---- | ------ | -------- | ----------------- |
| `batchId` | path | string | yes      | The delete batch. |

**Responses**

- **200** Success.

  Type: [RestoreBatchResult](#restorebatchresult)

- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

### DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id}/trash/{batchId}

Deletes a batch for good. Permissions: `MANAGE_PROJECT` (PMs).

**Permission:** Project member with `MANAGE_PROJECT` (PM). Non-members get 404.

| Parameter | In   | Type   | Required | Description       |
| --------- | ---- | ------ | -------- | ----------------- |
| `batchId` | path | string | yes      | The delete batch. |

**Responses**

- **204** Done; no body.
- Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 ([ApiError](#apierror))

## Schemas

### LoginDto

| Field      | Type   | Required | Description                                                        |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `email`    | string | yes      | Not checked as an email here: any mismatch is just a failed login. |
| `password` | string | yes      | No minimum on login, so old or temporary passwords still work.     |

### ChangePasswordDto

| Field             | Type   | Required | Description                                             |
| ----------------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `currentPassword` | string | yes      | The password the user currently has.                    |
| `newPassword`     | string | yes      | At least 12 characters; no composition rules (SPEC §5). |

### CreateUserDto

| Field         | Type                | Required | Description                                                                  |
| ------------- | ------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `email`       | string (email)      | yes      | Login email. TLDs are optional because internal mail domains often lack one. |
| `displayName` | string              | yes      | Name shown in the UI.                                                        |
| `systemRole`  | `"ADMIN"`, `"USER"` | no       | Defaults to `USER`.                                                          |

### UpdateUserDto

| Field         | Type                | Required | Description               |
| ------------- | ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------- |
| `displayName` | string              | no       | New display name.         |
| `systemRole`  | `"ADMIN"`, `"USER"` | no       | Promote or demote.        |
| `isActive`    | boolean             | no       | Deactivate or reactivate. |

### UpdateMeDto

| Field         | Type   | Required | Description       |
| ------------- | ------ | -------- | ----------------- |
| `displayName` | string | no       | New display name. |

| Field     | Type                            | Required | Description                                   |
| --------- | ------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`    | `"SYSTEM"`, `"LIGHT"`, `"DARK"` | yes      | Light, dark or the operating system's choice. |
| `primary` | string                          | yes      | Primary colour, `#RRGGBB`.                    |
| `accent`  | string                          | yes      | Accent colour, `#RRGGBB`.                     |

| ------------- | --------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `key`         | string          | yes      | 2–6 letters; lowercase input is uppercased.       |

| `description` | string          | no       | Optional plain-text description.                  |
| `pmUserIds`   | string (uuid)[] | yes      | The Project Managers: one or more distinct users. |

| `useInstanceHolidays`    | boolean                          | no       | The timeline uses the instance-wide holidays (M9.1).                        |
| `planLeadsOnly`          | boolean                          | no       | Only PMs and Leads change the plan of existing items (M9.2).                |
| `newItemBucketId`        | string (uuid) or null            | no       | "New items start in" (M12): a bucket of the project, or null for the first. |

| `description` | string                                                | no       | New description.    |
| `settings`    | [ProjectSettingsChangeDto](#projectsettingschangedto) | no       | Settings to change. |

Response of `GET /me/theme`: the caller's own theme, or null when they use the admin default.

| `theme` | [ThemeDto](#themedto) or null | yes      | The caller's theme, or null for "use default". |

### ThemeDto

A theme: mode plus primary and accent colour (SPEC §6). The web app derives the soft, line and ink variants of both colours and adjusts them until text on them reaches WCAG AA contrast (docs/DESIGN.md §2.1); the stored colours stay as chosen.

| Field     | Type                    | Required | Description                                             |
| --------- | ----------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`    | [ThemeMode](#thememode) | yes      | Light, dark, or the operating system's choice.          |
| `primary` | string                  | yes      | Primary colour, `#RRGGBB`.                              |
| `accent`  | string                  | yes      | Accent colour (unread badge, active sprint), `#RRGGBB`. |

### ThemeMode

Light or dark mode (SPEC §6). `SYSTEM` follows the operating system's preference.

One of `"SYSTEM"`, `"LIGHT"`, `"DARK"`.

### ProjectSettings

Project settings stored in `Project.settings` (SPEC §4). M8 adds the ADO export settings.

| Field                        | Type                      | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `membersCanAssignOthers`     | boolean                   | yes      | Lets Members assign items to others (SPEC §3.2; default off).                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `statusToBucket`             | object                    | yes      | Status → bucket moves; only buckets of the project, empty by default.                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `statusToBucket.NOT_STARTED` | string                    | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `statusToBucket.IN_PROGRESS` | string                    | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `statusToBucket.BLOCKED`     | string                    | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `statusToBucket.DONE`        | string                    | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `labelStyle`                 | [LabelStyle](#labelstyle) | yes      | How labels are drawn on cards and in the drawer (SPEC §4, §6; set by PMs).                                                                                                                                                                |
| `autoMoveDependents`         | boolean                   | yes      | Timeline date changes move dependent items without asking (SPEC §6.4, M9). Off when missing, so existing projects keep the confirmation; new projects start with it on.                                                                   |
| `useInstanceHolidays`        | boolean                   | yes      | The project's timeline uses the instance-wide holidays (M9.1; default on).                                                                                                                                                                |
| `holidaysReviewedAt`         | string or null            | yes      | When the project's PMs or Leads last reviewed instance holiday changes, or null (M9.1).                                                                                                                                                   |
| `planLeadsOnly`              | boolean                   | yes      | Only PMs, Leads and the item's team Leads change an existing item's plan: title, type, parent, sprint, dates, half days, pin and dependencies (M9.2; default on, also for projects from before it). Members still set them when creating. |
| `newItemBucketId`            | string or null            | yes      | "New items start in" (M12): the bucket for Stories, Tasks and Bugs created without one; null for the first bucket.                                                                                                                        |

### LabelStyle

Label styles a PM can choose per project (SPEC §4, docs/DESIGN.md §4.2): full-colour pills, soft tinted pills, or tinted pills plus a colour bar across the top of the card.

One of `"SOLID"`, `"TINTED"`, `"COVER"`.

### Visibility

Which items a Member or Viewer sees (SPEC §3.3). PMs and Leads always see everything, whatever is stored for them.

One of `"ALL"`, `"BUCKETS"`, `"OWN"`, `"TEAMS"`.

### TeamRole

Role inside an optional project team (SPEC §3.5).

One of `"LEAD"`, `"MEMBER"`.

### ProjectPermission

Permission names, one per row of the SPEC §3.2 table. Rows with a condition ("own/assigned only", "own created, no children") are split into an unconditional and an `_OWN` permission; the API checks the condition against the item.

One of `"VIEW_ITEMS"`, `"CREATE_ITEMS"`, `"EDIT_ANY_ITEM"`, `"EDIT_OWN_ITEMS"`, `"ASSIGN_OTHERS"`, `"MOVE_ANY_ITEM"`, `"MOVE_OWN_ITEMS"`, `"DELETE_ANY_ITEM"`, `"DELETE_OWN_ITEMS"`, `"ANNOTATE_ITEMS"`, `"MANAGE_BOARD"`, `"MANAGE_MEMBERS"`, `"ASSIGN_PMS"`, `"MANAGE_PROJECT"`, `"EXPORT_ADO"`, `"IMPORT_ADO"`.

One of `"Basic"`, `"Agile"`, `"Scrum"`, `"CMMI"`, `"Custom"`.

| `types`              | string[]                                                      | yes      | Distinct work item types.                                          |
| `states`             | object[]                                                      | yes      | Distinct type/state pairs.                                         |
| `states[].type`      | string                                                        | yes      |                                                                    |
| `states[].state`     | string                                                        | yes      |                                                                    |
| `tags`               | string[]                                                      | yes      | Distinct tags.                                                     |
| `iterations`         | string[]                                                      | yes      | Distinct iteration paths.                                          |
| `identities`         | object[]                                                      | yes      | Distinct identities as exported, with the email when present.      |
| `identities[].value` | string                                                        | yes      |                                                                    |
| `identities[].email` | string or null                                                | yes      |                                                                    |
| `dateHeaders`        | string[]                                                      | yes      | Date columns present.                                              |
| `dateOrder`          | `"DMY"`, `"MDY"` or null                                      | yes      | Day/month order when the dates prove it, otherwise null.           |
| `rows`               | number                                                        | yes      | Rows read.                                                         |

### AdoPreviewRow

One reviewed row, without raw CSV or hidden-project information.

| Field         | Type                                                                                                | Required | Description                                                 |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `index`       | number                                                                                              | yes      | Zero-based CSV row or outgoing item order.                  |
| `itemId`      | string or null                                                                                      | yes      | Local item identity when known.                             |
| `remoteId`    | string or null                                                                                      | yes      | Positive remote ID, never converted to a JavaScript number. |
| `title`       | string                                                                                              | yes      | Human-readable title.                                       |
| `kind`        | `"link"`, `"create"`, `"update"`, `"observe"`, `"unchanged"`, `"pending"`, `"context"`, `"omitted"` | yes      | Classification.                                             |
| `selected`    | boolean                                                                                             | yes      | Distinguishes explicit selection from ancestors.            |
| `differences` | [AdoDifference](#adodifference)[]                                                                   | yes      | Three-way differences.                                      |
| `warnings`    | string[]                                                                                            | yes      | Losses and required explicit resolutions.                   |
| `changes`     | [AdoField](#adofield)[]                                                                             | no       | Fields this row actually sends to ADO or applies here.      |

### AdoDifference

Visible three-way field comparison; rendered as text, never trusted HTML.

| Field            | Type                              | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `field`          | [AdoField](#adofield)             | yes      | Local field.                                                                                                                                                   |
| `local`          |                                   | yes      | Present local value.                                                                                                                                           |
| `incoming`       |                                   | yes      | Normalized incoming value.                                                                                                                                     |
| `baselineLocal`  |                                   | yes      | Last confirmed local value or null.                                                                                                                            |
| `baselineRemote` |                                   | yes      | Last confirmed remote value or null.                                                                                                                           |
| `conflict`       | boolean                           | yes      | Both sides changed since confirmation, or no confirmed baseline exists.                                                                                        |
| `choice`         | `"local"`, `"incoming"`, `"skip"` | no       | Current resolution, explicit or chosen by Quick review.                                                                                                        |
| `auto`           | boolean                           | no       | True when Quick review chose this because only one side changed.                                                                                               |
| `newItem`        | boolean                           | no       | True for a row that becomes a new Kloister item: there is no Kloister value or last sync to compare, so the only choices are to take or leave out ADO's value. |

### AdoField

Transferable scalar fields. Missing columns preserve local values.

One of `"description"`, `"type"`, `"priority"`, `"labelIds"`, `"sprintId"`, `"startDate"`, `"dueDate"`, `"title"`, `"status"`, `"assigneeIds"`, `"parentId"`, `"bucketId"`.

| `fields`             | object        | yes      | Fields that will change, with how many rows each.      |
| `fields.description` | number        | no       |                                                        |
| `fields.type`        | number        | no       |                                                        |
| `fields.priority`    | number        | no       |                                                        |
| `fields.labelIds`    | number        | no       |                                                        |
| `fields.sprintId`    | number        | no       |                                                        |
| `fields.startDate`   | number        | no       |                                                        |
| `fields.dueDate`     | number        | no       |                                                        |
| `fields.title`       | number        | no       |                                                        |
| `fields.status`      | number        | no       |                                                        |
| `fields.assigneeIds` | number        | no       |                                                        |
| `fields.parentId`    | number        | no       |                                                        |
| `fields.bucketId`    | number        | no       |                                                        |
| `conflicts`          | number        | yes      | Fields changed on both sides that still need a choice. |
